status: Fixed-cost precision follow-up chosen after the 100k source analysis and the unsuccessful two-phase precision attempt; source/model definitions unchanged
combined_batch_rule: For each original batch b=0..99, sum its 1000 marked permutations with increment counters [8200100000+9000*b,8200100000+9000*(b+1)). These are 100 disjoint equal-sized unions, not the original contiguous 1M/100 partition. The two orientations always share the same union. N260 and N340 retain distinct original seeds.
other_sizes: N65,N85,N130,N170 reuse their saved first100k data and paired covariance; no repeat reobservation
primary_estimator: Original self-rooted raw bulk Udot, with the same exact thermal/root/slope definition and delta_cos4. No result-selected estimator or exponent.
root_comoving_composition: Additional exploratory low-order mechanism readout fixed before the increment: d mean(P_rank1)/dt = -N*(mean(JE)-mean(E_p)*mean(Jq)/D) in internal density units. A common affine-K thermal clock gives exactly zero. This tests finite root-comoving topology composition, not energy-field identification or an independent source.
activation_root_contributions: r1=-N*(mean(Jq)-mean(JE))/(2D); r2=-N*(mean(Jq)+mean(JE))/(2D). These statically partition the total root derivative through the two cumulative activation indicators, not event-local birth mechanisms.
generator_baseline: Reconstruct q/E anchor from full production minus ALL marked permutations: 100k excluded at cyclic sizes,1M at each endpoint. Propagate its disjoint complement delete-one covariance with actual batch weights. The old two-phase complement overlaps the new900k and must not be reused as an independent anchor.
model_extensions: Same common-fugacity q2/Jordan source-rigidity and one-generator-drift hypotheses as analysis/norm4_source_tangent_hypotheses.json; the ordinary full-production law is not replaced by low-precision source-subset U
report: Actual source response and both chain residuals after the fixed increment, complete aligned-batch covariance, old-versus-expanded paired differences, actual runtime and hashes. First100k and combined1M are nested, not independent experiments.
acquisition: Deterministically reobserve cluster marks on 900k already-produced old permutations per endpoint; no new Monte Carlo sample, no server/GPU, no test suite. Run this fixed increment once, no significance-dependent continuation.
